items.title: Zester Limited
items.imageAlt: Zester at the JA Hong Kong Company of the Year finals

fields.label: What it was
fields.body: Zester teaches the UN Sustainable Development Goals through a card game called Chief Zester of Earth. It grew out of a school project at Island School into a full social enterprise, now with a digital learning platform (ZestLabs) alongside the card game and in-person workshops for schools and corporates.

fields.label: My role
fields.body: Co-founder, COO & CFO. I run day-to-day operations and partner relationships on the COO side, and bookkeeping, tax filings, and sponsorship budgeting on the CFO side.

fields.label: What I produced
fields.body: Built out our school and corporate network to 44+ schools and partners including HSBC, BNY, and TTI, delivered 6 sustainability workshops across Hong Kong and London, and ran the SDG Innovation League, an inter-school competition, from the ground up.

fields.label: What came of it
fields.body: 30,000+ students reached, with 2,000+ active on ZestLabs. Zester won JA Asia Pacific Company of the Year, 1st out of 81,000+ students, and placed in the top 6 globally out of 32,000 teams at the De La Vega Global Entrepreneurship Awards.

fields.label: What it was
fields.body: A conference co-hosted by HKSTP and CLP on sustainable residential living, bringing together 10 tech ventures and 280+ participants, with the Housing Society attending as Guest of Honour.

fields.label: My role
fields.body: Person-in-Charge, running point on the event from planning through to the day itself. Also acted as emcee of the conference.

fields.label: What I produced
fields.body: Coordinated with 10 HKSTP tech ventures, 2 external event agencies, and internal teams on the full rundown and day-of logistics, and hosted the conference as emcee.

fields.label: What came of it
fields.body: A full-day conference delivered for 230+ participants and 10 tech ventures, with Chairman of Hong Kong Housing Society Prof. Ling Kar-kan represented as Guest of Honour.

items.title: SDG Innovation League
items.role: Head of Operations & Finance, Organising Committee

fields.label: What it was
fields.body: A three-phase sustainability innovation competition for secondary school students, co-organised by Zester with HKU's Faculty of Education, Ocean Park, and UN SDSN HK. Students across 17 schools worked in teams to ideate, build, and pitch their own SDG projects to industry judges.

fields.label: My role
fields.body: Head of Operations & Finance on the organising committee.

fields.label: What I produced
fields.body: Secured HK$350K+ in sponsorship from HKU, Ocean Park, and UN SDSN HK, directed logistics across all three phases including a full-day launch event and the final judging round, and coordinated 62 staff and volunteers.

fields.label: What came of it
fields.body: 250+ students across 17 schools took part, and the competition ran on budget and on schedule.

items.title: Market Strategy & Expansion: Women's Premium Activewear Brand

fields.label: What it was
fields.body: A 9-week consulting engagement through ICC at HKUST for a women's premium activewear brand based in Hong Kong. Working with a 6-person team, we diagnosed brand positioning gaps and identified growth opportunities across retail and digital channels.

fields.label: My role
fields.body: Project Consultant, leading market sizing, competitor benchmarking, customer research, and sales-channel analysis.

fields.label: What I produced
fields.body: Benchmarked 6 competitors and around 15 Instagram accounts, and pulled together findings from 60+ survey responses, 15 focus group participants, and 2 site visits in Causeway Bay. Analysed sales performance across 4 channels and put together a 25-slide final deck.

fields.label: What came of it
fields.body: 3 recommendations delivered to the client on in-store experience, brand messaging, and customer engagement.

items.title: Cross-City Comparative Study on Job Vacancy Trends

fields.label: What it was
fields.body: A cross-city comparative study on job vacancy trends for Liber Research Community, an independent Hong Kong policy think tank, looking at whether Hong Kong's declining job openings are a local labour market issue or part of a broader global pattern.

fields.label: My role
fields.body: Researcher (Volunteer), sourcing and analysing the data and writing up the findings for a policy audience.

fields.label: What I produced
fields.body: Pulled together around 10 public datasets into a spreadsheet model comparing unemployment-to-vacancy ratios across major global cities, then wrote the analysis up for publication.

fields.label: What came of it
fields.body: Published across 3 channels, reaching 4,000+ engagements and 100K+ overall reach, and later cited in an HK01 article on Hong Kong's labour market.
